requirements.title: Version endpoint: the service names the commit it runs
Uptime endpoint: the service reports how long it has been up
Info endpoint: the service names itself and its region

acceptance.text: GET /api/info returns {service, region, started_at}, with started_at the time the app started as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

requirements.title: Ping endpoint: a cheap liveness probe

acceptance.text: GET /api/time returns {now}, the server's current time as an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

requirements.title: Echo endpoint: returns what it is sent

acceptance.text: GET /api/echo?msg=<text> returns {msg: <text>}; with no msg parameter it returns {msg: ""}
GET /api/sum?a=<int>&b=<int> returns {sum: a+b}; a missing or non-integer parameter returns HTTP 422
